name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: A face, circled in felt tip. The picture is circled by a hand-drawn loop; without one the initials sit on a disc of marker in a stationery color chosen from the name. A status dot goes on the corner, and a group overlaps its faces and ends in a sketched "+3".

a11y: The loop, the disc and the dot are aria-hidden decoration. Give the picture an `alt` (or `alt=""` next to the name in text), and give AvatarFallback a `name` so the person is read out instead of two letters.
Color is never the only carrier: the initials say who, and the badge needs its own text for its meaning (online, busy). The initials are ink on a 62% marker, 5.5:1 or better on all eight colors.
An avatar is not interactive. Wrap it in a Button or link yourself, and the hand-drawn loop then sits inside that control's focus ring.
The same name is always the same color on the server and in the browser (a hash of the trimmed, lower-cased name), so nothing changes at hydration.
Windows high contrast removes the drawings and keeps the picture or initials.
meta.usage:
import { Avatar, AvatarBadge, AvatarFallback, AvatarGroup, AvatarGroupCount, AvatarImage } from "@/components/ui/avatar"

export function Example() {
  return (
    <AvatarGroup>
      <Avatar>
        <AvatarImage src="/ada.png" alt="Ada Lovelace" />
        <AvatarFallback name="Ada Lovelace" />
        <AvatarBadge status="online" />
      </Avatar>
      <Avatar>
        <AvatarFallback name="Jo Okafor" />
      </Avatar>
      <AvatarGroupCount>+3</AvatarGroupCount>
    </AvatarGroup>
  )
}
